text: On alaa e rewde gaanin Alla, si wanaa inɗe ɗe hikkaaki nokku, ɗe innitirɗon onon e baabiraaɓe mon reweteeɗe, ɗe alah non huunde e geɓal ka reweede, Alla jippinanaali kon ko innitirɗon ɗe hujja tinndinoowo sellugol ɗe. Ñaawoore tagu ngun fow alanaa si wanaa Alla gooto On, wanah ɗee inɗe ɗe innitirɗon onon e baabiraaɓe mon. Alla yamirii on nde bajjinɗinirton Mo dewal, O haɗi on kafidugol Mo e goɗɗum goo. Ko ɗum woni diina ñiiɓuka ka ooñaare alaa e mu'un; kono ko ɓuri ɗuuɗude e yimɓe ɓen anndaa ɗum, ko ɗum waɗi si ɓe sirkannde Alla, ɓe rewa tagaaɗi goo.
